import hashlib, json, pathlib, sys
from importlib.metadata import distributions
import repropatch
from repropatch import agent_runtime, models
from repropatch.cli import main
assert repropatch.__version__ == sys.argv[2]
location = pathlib.Path(repropatch.__file__).parent
assert location.is_relative_to(sys.prefix)
assert 'agents' not in sys.modules and 'openai' not in sys.modules
source = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]) / 'src/repropatch'
for path in source.glob('*.py'):
    assert path.read_bytes() == (location / path.name).read_bytes(), path
packages = {item.metadata['Name'].lower(): item.version for item in distributions()}
if sys.argv[3] == 'core':
    assert 'agents' not in packages and 'openai' not in packages and 'openai-agents' not in packages
else:
    models.prepare_sdk()
    for name, version in {'openai-agents':'0.24.0', 'openai':'3.35.1',
                          'httpx2':'2.15.1', 'pydantic':'2.14.1'}.items():
        assert packages[name] == version
print(json.dumps({'location':str(location),'packages':packages,
                  'source_bytes_match':True,'lazy_import_verified':True}, indent=2))
